expert_commentary: This DAG captures the causal mechanisms: account age influences transaction behavior which in turn influences the probability of fraud. Contextual variables (location, device) interact with each other before affecting fraud.

liens.raison: Younger accounts have less transaction history
Time of transaction influences transaction amount
Older accounts have more normal transaction amounts
Previous fraudulent transactions increase the likelihood of current fraud
Abnormally high activity is a signal of fraud
Anomalous transaction amounts are a signal of fraud
